business_problem: Li Auto needed stable, high-efficiency cloud services to support fast-growing in-vehicle digital content, intelligent-cockpit interaction, and always-on vehicle services without compromising safety, user experience, or the pace of product innovation.
solution_summary: Li Auto uses Baidu AI Cloud as part of the cloud base behind its intelligent electric-vehicle service ecosystem. The source highlights three core products: BCC for stable compute resources, Qianfan AppBuilder for application delivery, and Qianfan ModelBuilder for model-development capability. Together these services support the large and growing cloud-service demand created by content updates inside the cockpit and by interactive services delivered to drivers and passengers across many travel scenarios. Baidu positions the stack as the underlying platform that provides stable, efficient, and intelligent cloud services, while Li Auto applies it to improve both safe-driving support and intelligent-interaction experience.

solution_components.name: BCC
solution_components.role: Provides the stable cloud-compute foundation used for Li Auto's vehicle-facing digital services.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports application development and delivery for interactive in-car and travel-related cloud services.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Adds model-development capability for intelligent interaction and service evolution in the cockpit ecosystem.

data_flow: Vehicle-service requests and digital content updates are handled through Baidu's cloud platform, where compute and model services support application delivery back into Li Auto's intelligent cockpit and related service scenarios.
business_outcome: Li Auto strengthened the cloud-backed digital-service ecosystem around its intelligent electric vehicles and improved the interaction foundation for safer, richer in-cabin user experiences.
architecture_clues: The case is framed around cloud support for large volumes of cockpit content and travel-scene interaction
Qianfan application and model platforms are positioned alongside core compute rather than as isolated experiments
The same stack supports service expansion across multiple Li Auto models
